## Direction
- Do: build one system the agents run on, so the work comes out consistent.
- For: the people directing it.
- Why: consistency is how a small team scales without losing quality.

## Because
- The public readme names one system for every agent (finding:public-readme)
- The core segment already runs more than one site (focus.segment.core)

## Watch
- If pages shipped with a hand edit > 0 in any month, then review whether the agents still share one system.
